about_the_game:
If you’re really enjoying StormEdge and want to support our development, grabbing this pack would be an awesome way to do it — this will be a great contribution, we swear!

By getting the pack, you’ll unlock some cool extras that will make your experience even more enjoyable:

  • StormEdge Original Soundtrack Composed by Jeff Deng


    The album blends a diverse range of musical elements, including experimental, epic, electronic, and ethnic music. Through experimental techniques and tones, it creates an atmosphere of tension and danger within the game, allowing players to feel the impact and rhythm of the music with every action-packed moment.

    The album contains a total of 23 tracks, available in 320kbps MP3 and lossless WAV formats.

    Don't forget! The soundtrack will be added to your installation game folder once you've installed the DLC.

    To find the OST from the Supporter pack, follow these steps to access the game's folder. You can do this in two ways.

    Method 1: Using Steam
    The easiest method is through the Steam interface:

    1. Open your Steam library and right-click on the game.
    2. Select "Properties" from the menu.
    3. In the window that appears, click on the "Installed Files" tab.
    4. Click the "Browse" button. This will open a file explorer window.
    5. You’re now in the game folder! Locate and open the "StormEdge Original Soundtrack" folder to listen to the soundtrack.

    Method 2: Direct Access
    You can also access the game's folder directly through your file explorer.
    The typical location is:
    C:\Steam\steamapps\common\StormEdge\StormEdge Original Soundtrack

    Enjoy the music! 🎶

  • Additional skins for each character


    Try out the exclusive outfits of StormEdge heroes for a new rewarding visual experience!



These goodies won’t change the core gameplay, but they’ll help you dive even deeper into the magical world of StormEdge!
